title: Stage-3 Dosage-Aware Genomic Selection Pipeline for Hexaploid Sweetpotato: Simulation-Validated Reference Implementation
description:
Reference R implementation of the Stage-3 pilot dosage-aware genomic-selection pipeline described in Table 5 (Section 7) of: Nguyen T.D., Pham Q.T., Nguyen T.T., Doan T.T., Vu T.X.B., Nguyen V.L., "AI-assisted genomic selection in sweetpotato: A staged roadmap for polyploid, clonal-propagated breeding", Ecological Genetics and Genomics 41 (2026) 100530, doi:10.1016/j.egg.2026.100530.

The pipeline covers dosage-uncertain genotype calling with polyRAD, hexaploid additive genomic relationship-matrix construction with AGHmatrix (VanRaden method extended to ploidy 6), dosage-aware GBLUP with sommer across five target traits evaluated by five-fold cross-validation, an MGIDI classical Stage-1 baseline with metan matched to the same five-trait scope, and a 10,000-resample bootstrap confidence-interval gate test of the accuracy difference between the two. No genotyping-by-sequencing data yet exists for the authors' own sweetpotato panel, so every stage is validated end to end on a simulated 315-progeny biparental hexaploid population; only the data-loading step needs to change once real genotyping data becomes available. All shipped genotypes and phenotypes are simulated.

Released under the MIT license and archived via the Zenodo-GitHub integration. See CITATION.cff for full author and citation metadata.
